family: redundant 5R with two determined spares (cam-slaved knuckles, both from q2)
verdict: DEAD, converged over 4034 configurations. Best: 26.62 fast near-touch (plain 26.62) and 34.18 frozen exact on Bench(110,360) (near-touch 36.89, reach 0.728, fold 84 = the winner's 84), against the winner's 16.53 / 23.37-23.57 through the same code. The lead's law-only kill gate PASSES at the spec's seat: K2 covers 8 of 8 folded fit poses and 17 of 23 folded verify poses, with hub 2 / K2 / hub 3 inside their levels except one hub-2 pose at +3.7 mm. The same seat's metal fails: the control with K2's law off measures 52.92. The search's optimum makes K2 do nothing (it bends 4.7 deg).
limiter: (1) Engagement against metal. The law out-runs th at the 5-deg kit margin only if K2 rests bent at psi0 <= 135 (0 % engage at 150-165). There, K2's O20 hub stands 70-116 mm and is <= 0.12 in band, and the link-2 dog-leg leaves the band. K2's metal alone costs 6.7 points at the cheapest seat (control 23.25, law off, against 16.53). (2) Where K2 does extend the fold limit (by 10.5 deg: th_min 20.8, a2e 61.6 -> 51.4), link 2 lies back over link 1 at the folded end. K2 then lands on the K drive's pushrod (-5.2 mm on #126) and on hub K, so the truly folded poses are lost to parts and the knee slide. (3) The folded side's prize (+0.064 verify reach) is below K2's metal cost.
note: Model: the winner (geneva-tail-knuckle-pinknee-3r, rod embodiment) loaded as its own copy, plus K2 on link 2. Members: 8 = link 2a, 2 = link 2b. The exact folded law: q2 = q2lo + s_f t, dK2 = s2 kK2 t, inverted per pose. Its gates: monotone, rate <= 3.45, the kit's m3e >= 5 on (a1, a2e), K2 dyad >= 5, lift-off, stop B2, pressure angle <= 45. q1 and q3 are closed form. K2 metal: O20 hub, +6 mm spring cap, rocker, rod, rod ends and horn (high or low variant). The checks cover all 5 hubs, the 4 straps and both drives against each other. SPEC CORRECTION: a crown or rim follower lever from K2 to hub 2 gives kK2 <= 0.3 at pa 45; the law needs 1.0-1.5, so K2 uses the winner's rod embodiment mirrored on hub 2's stator. Search: 244 + 256 farm configs (20 controls), then 6 CMA streams (3534 evals); idle K2 is flagged dishonest (+100). Convergence gate, best stream s3: 2nd half 0.04, last third 0.04, top-5 spread 0.03 gap points. Loosest stream s6: 1.24 / 0.13 / 0.67 gap points (0.45 / 0.05 / 0.24 score). Passes. Frozen exact Bench(110,360) of the s3 best: 34.18. Frozen of the coarse best A: 38.46 (fit 30.88). Simplification: K2's rod and horn are sampled on link 2a. No clip engages K2, so in-band is exact; the folded-pose collisions would only get worse.
